winning_class.name: Destructive-Inquiry Class
winning_class.one_liner: The object is already occupied by a non-destructive method; the remaining unknown is closed only by a protocol that consumes the object or its only copies; no non-destructive surrogate owns that unknown.
operators: Non-destructive occupancy — already detected without consuming the object
Identity/function still closed — more of the same non-destructive method does not close it
Closing protocol consumes — collection, drilling, culture, dissection, or extraction irreversibly alters the object or its only copies
Surrogate census fails — no existing non-destructive method is the literature's object for the same unknown

why_not_prior.UND: Looking already happened. More of the same look does not close it.
why_not_prior.TAC: Not a named-dark signal missing a converter. The noun is on camera. The verb (identity/role) requires taking it.
why_not_prior.NCR: No insufficient official cause. There is no cause yet.
why_not_prior.FAC: No two-camp dispute. Consensus that the hadal animal is unplaced.
why_not_prior.CIC: Watching longer video of the same animal does not yield a phylum.
why_not_prior.JAC: Not a missing foreign key between two existing ledgers.
why_not_prior.IOA: Not two scales of one named process. One object. One missing destructive step.

iterate_second_class.one_liner: A documented unknown is closeable only by an instrument or mission whose remaining lifetime is shorter than the closure time; turning it off enlarges the unknown. Distinct from never-looking (UND) and from looking-that-destroys (DIC).
iterate_second_class.why_not_dic: The object (Venus, dark energy, ice giants) is not consumed. The chance to know is.
iterate_second_class.why_not_und: The looking was funded, built, in some cases already flying. Withdrawal is not absence of a look.
iterate_second_class.primary_instance: NASA FY proposal to cancel 41 science missions (Planetary Society 2026-09-06), including DAVINCI.
iterate_second_class.status: LOGGED AS SECONDARY, not today's primary. One-day-old policy object. Do not load-bear as a law of nature.
iterate_second_class.novelty_note: Institutional, not physical. Valid as a closure-failure mode. Not a discovery of nature.

capability_gap: No existing tool tracks, against a local archive of already-claimed structural classes, whether an object already occupied by a non-destructive method has a remaining unknown whose only closing protocol consumes the object, after a surrogate census has failed.
not_claimed: Not that the hadal animal is a new phylum.
Not that collection is impossible — only that current collection ruins the evidence.
Not that ice-sheet basal sliding lacks a field (it has one; inverse models own it).
Not that dark oxygen is real.
Not that trees talk, not CBR, not Dark Biosphere.
Not that NASA cancellations are a law of nature.
Not patent-ready, not peer-reviewed, not a discovery of nature.
